# - round 3 is not listed two times (true if count != 2)
# - all other rounds are listed two times (true if all other round counts == 2)

# Get all unique rounds
all_rounds = df['round'].unique()

# Check condition for all rounds
condition_holds = True
for r in all_rounds:
    count = round_counts.get(r, 0)
    if r == 3:
        if count == 2:
            condition_holds = False
            break
    else:
        if count != 2:
            condition_holds = False
            break
